title: List view kanban over a lookup lane: lane count and summarizeField total cover only the loaded page
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYnagJvGbCtNg2PhvgW

Filing gate ① — a user-visible defect with named locations. Source: fleet (out-of-scope finding of the #36871 dev, os-dev-report 7163480862; carried in PR #37295's Acceptance notes and listed by the seat for filing). Same family as #36871, which fixed the lane foot's sum/avg/min/max on this board.

Grading: `area:ux` · Bug · p2 (a wrong number shown as a lane total, unmarked) · reach: measured in the #36871 rig, a real ListView board laned on a lookup with 60 rows and pageSize 25 · evidence: measured.

## What happens

On ListView's rows-handed board (lanes over a lookup field, one page of records):
- The lane header count and the foot `count` statistic count the page, with no `+` (`laneCountLabel`, `KanbanImpl.tsx:767`; `countsAreWindowed` is tied to the board's own fetch, `KanbanBoardCore.tsx:169`). In the rig, lanes of 30 and 30 read 13 and 12.
- A lane whose records all fall past the first page is not drawn.
- The `summarizeField` header total (`KanbanImpl.tsx:801`) sums the page.

#36871 made the same board's foot `sum`/`avg`/`min`/`max` whole-lane figures by handing it the page's query (`laneStatisticQuery`); these three readings still read the page.

## Expected

The same board reads the lane count and the `summarizeField` total over every record of the lane (through the grouped lane read #36871 added), or marks them as page figures (`13+`). A lane with records only past the first page is still drawn.

## Done when

- A pin in the #36871 rig (`listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`) reads whole-lane or marked counts, a lane drawn for records past page one, and a whole-lane `summarizeField` total, each with a control.
- An ablation of each fix turns its pin red.

## Why

A sales user grouping opportunities by account reads "13" and a page-sized total as the account's numbers; they are wrong by however many records sit past the first page.

Reader: the `area:ux` zone (a4-C) dispatches it to an os-dev. Dedupe: `summarizeField page` → 15 hits, 1 open (#34989, a different mechanism: views bound to a withheld field); `lane count page handed` → no open card on this mechanism.
